description: Create a new contract for signing, either from HTML content or from a PDF file. Returns a signing URL that can be shared with signers, and can e-mail a link of their own to individual signers (`signers`). Give exactly one of `content` (HTML) or `document` (a PDF).

attachments.description: Extra forms appended to the signed PDF, for example the German housing cooperative sublet registration. Call list_attachment_types first to learn which types exist and which fields each one needs.

fields.description: Field values for this attachment, as declared by its type

content.description: HTML content of the contract. Signature fields are appended below it as a block; coordinates are not accepted with HTML.

document.description: Your own PDF instead of HTML content. Signature fields are then placed on its pages by coordinates. Up to 3 MB.

name.description: File name shown to the signer

path.description: Absolute path of a PDF file on this machine

pdf.description: The PDF as base64, if no path is given

finalize.description: If true, the contract will be finalized and ready for signing. If false, it will be saved as a draft.

language.description: Language of the signing page, e-mails and audit certificate (default: en)

signatureFields.description: Signature fields, one per signature to collect. Fields with the same label belong to the same signer. With a `document`, x and y are required and position the field; with HTML content, only `label` is allowed. With a `document`, `type` also places initials, the signing date, fixed text or text the signer types.

height.description: PDF only: height in percent of the page (default: 10)

label.description: Name of the signer (e.g., "Client", "Landlord", "Provider"). Required for every type except "text"

optional.description: Only with type "input": the signer may leave it empty

text.description: With type "text": required, the text to print, at most 500 characters. With type "input": optional, the default the signer starts with, at most 200

type.description: PDF only for anything but "signature" (default). "initials": the signer named by label initials here. "date": the day the signer named by label signs; that label needs a signature or initials field. "text": prints `text` as is, needs `text`, no label needed. "input": the signer named by label types it while signing, `text` is the default

width.description: PDF only: width in percent of the page (default: 25)

x.description: PDF only: left edge of the field in percent of the page width, measured from the left

y.description: PDF only: top edge of the field in percent of the page height, measured from the top (0 = top edge, 90 = near the bottom)

signers.description: Optional, one entry per field label. With `email` the signer gets a signing link of their own by e-mail: it opens only the fields of that label, and the audit certificate records the address as "link delivered to". Without `email` the signer uses the shared signUrl, so one party can sign by link and another in the same room; such an entry can still preset a `title`. Links go out once the contract is ready for signing. At most 5 sends per signer in 24 hours.

email.description: Optional: address the signing link is sent to, and only there. Omit it to keep the shared signUrl

label.description: The signature field label this signer signs, e.g. "Client"

level.description: Only with email: "ses" (default) signs in the dialog; "qes" signs with a qualified electronic signature at the provider, after every other signer

title.description: Optional: what the signer signs as, e.g. "Managing Director", at most 80 characters. Preset in the sign dialog and printed in the stamp; the signer can change it

name: create_contract
